findings.name: Play overtakes a coalesced seek
findings.cause: A second seek set seekAgain and resolved immediately. Play proceeded before the active seek settled. A valid delivery order of real seek and Play replies let the old follow-up seek see playing, then issue pause and seek0 after Play.

findings.name: Paused/error replies leave false playback text
findings.cause: Play wrote a success label without inspecting its acknowledgement. Polling updated only playing/completed replies, leaving paused/ready/cancelled/error state and time invisible.

changes: Coalesced seek callers share the entire active seek promise, including follow-up requests.
Playback, pause, focus, camera mode, camera capture and actor selection toolbar operations are ordered after earlier operations and pending seeks; work-epoch guards reject stale queued work.
Play and Pause labels and clocks derive from the returned state/time. Polling also reflects paused, ready, cancelled and error states, and guards stale work, active seeks and loading.
The motion section explains that body clips and timing are separate from the position path.

focusedCoverage: paused/ready/cancelled/error time and labels for both state/status response fields
existing cold actor add, selection/edit/save/reopen and authoring regressions
